findings.statement: CA9 ranks first in the convergence ranking; in the scRNA-seq the tumour (RCC) cells hold nearly all tissue transcripts, so the bulk signal is tumour-intrinsic [gene=CA9; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=RCC; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.976], and it is essentially absent from proximal tubule cells (tumour-vs-PT log2FC [gene=CA9; type=sc_tumor_vs_pt; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; log2fc=7.739]).

In Visium, CA9 high-expression spots are explained almost entirely by RCC spots in the composition-corrected attribution, and their ring-1 neighbours are enriched in RCC and, more weakly, in macrophages (both significant after BH adjustment), consistent with tumour-cell clusters rather than a stromal source.

The AlphaFold CA9 model shows its best detected cavity with a volume of [gene=CA9; type=structural_context; source=DATASET:ALPHAFOLD-DB; volume_a3=126.8] cubic angstrom and a modest structural-context score; detected cavities recover half of experimental ligand-contact residues. This is a descriptive monomer heuristic, not evidence of degron or ligase compatibility; CA9 already has antibody and sulfonamide-class clinical history.

CD70 is rank four in convergence, replicated in TCGA and with a log2FC that stays large when extrapolated to a pure tumour, so it is not an infiltration artefact; in the single-cell data RCC cells are the group with the highest per-cell level but Tregs and other lymphocytes also express it, so tumour-cell specificity is partial. Clinical-stage CD70 antibodies exist (not first-in-class).

MET transcripts are overwhelmingly in tumour cells, with a minor endothelial contribution, so MET is a tumour-cell target rather than a microenvironment one [gene=MET; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=RCC; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.935].

EPAS1 (HIF-2alpha) transcripts in this scRNA-seq sit mainly in endothelium and fibroblasts, not in RCC cells, whose share is small [gene=EPAS1; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=RCC; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.051]; endothelium holds [gene=EPAS1; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=Endothelial; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.365]. Bulk RNA therefore cannot be read as tumour-intrinsic, and RNA level may under-represent the HIF-2 pathway activity in tumour cells.

KDR is an endothelial gene: endothelial cells hold nearly all its tumour transcripts [gene=KDR; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=Endothelial; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.951], so it is a microenvironment (anti-angiogenic) target and not a tumour-cell target.

CD74 is immune-derived: macrophages carry the largest transcript share [gene=CD74; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=Macrophage; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.436], with dendritic cells showing the highest per-cell level and nearly all myeloid and B cells expressing it, so a bulk CD74 rise reflects antigen-presenting infiltrate, not tumour cells.

CXCR4 is expressed by lymphocytes; CD8 T cells hold the largest share simply because of their numbers [gene=CXCR4; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=CD8_T; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.563], and CD4 T cells have the highest per-cell level, so it is an immune-microenvironment gene.

NNMT ranks eighth in convergence, is purity-robust and TCGA-replicated, and has adverse, BH-significant TCGA survival with no clinical drug, making it a tumour-intrinsic biomarker candidate; the cell-type attribution was not queried here, so tumour-cell origin rests on purity extrapolation only.

COL23A1 (tumour track, first) is made by RCC cells, which hold most of its tumour transcripts [gene=COL23A1; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=tumor; source_share=0.881]; it is replicated in TCGA (log2FC [gene=COL23A1; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=tumor; tcga_log2fc=5.829]) and stays high when extrapolated to a pure tumour [gene=COL23A1; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=tumor; rna_lfc_at_purity1=4.88]. It has few ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, low vital-organ expression and a UniProt cell-membrane annotation (SURFY and CSPA do not confirm surface exposure); survival is not adverse and DepMap shows no dependency, so this is a hypothesis only.

The AlphaFold model of COL23A1 is low confidence overall (mean pLDDT [gene=COL23A1; type=alphafold_model; source=DATASET:ALPHAFOLD-DB; mean_plddt=58.91]) and its single detected cavity is tiny and shallow, with no ligand-site validation available; a monomer cavity heuristic is poorly suited to a collagen, so structure-based tractability is unsupported (this does not exclude antibody targeting).

RAB42 (tumour track, second) is expressed mainly by RCC cells [gene=RAB42; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=tumor; source_share=0.627], is up in TCGA and purity-robust, has very few ccRCC papers and no clinical drug, but is an internal (not surface) small GTPase, survival is not adverse and no dependency is seen; it is a hypothesis lacking functional evidence.

OLFML2A (stroma track) is a secreted fibroblast gene, with fibroblasts holding most of its transcripts [gene=OLFML2A; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=stroma; source_share=0.647]; it is TCGA-replicated, purity-robust, with few ccRCC papers and no clinical drug, but expression in colon (vital organ) is not negligible, survival is not adverse and no dependency is shown.

JAG2 (stroma track) is a Notch ligand made mostly by endothelium [gene=JAG2; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=stroma; source_share=0.487]; it is TCGA-replicated and purity-robust with an antibody-tractable surface/secreted profile and no clinical drug, but heart expression, a modest tumour-vs-normal change and no dependency or survival signal limit it; this is a microenvironment hypothesis.

MILR1 (immune track, first) is a macrophage mast-cell-receptor gene with no ccRCC papers and no clinical drug, and it has adverse TCGA survival; however the RNA log2FC collapses when extrapolated to a pure tumour [gene=MILR1; type=purity; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PURITY; rna_lfc_at_purity1=0.414], flagging infiltration-driven signal, so it reports macrophage abundance more than a tumour-cell change.

GAL3ST4 (immune track) is almost entirely macrophage-derived [gene=GAL3ST4; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=immune; source_share=0.972], is purity-robust and associates with adverse TCGA survival, but it is an internal enzyme (not antibody-accessible) with only one ccRCC paper, and has no dependency evidence.

LILRB4 (immune track) is a surface myeloid checkpoint on macrophages, replicated in TCGA, but its signal is infiltration-driven (RNA log2FC extrapolated to a pure tumour [gene=LILRB4; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=immune; rna_lfc_at_purity1=0.508]), so it is a microenvironment candidate whose tumour-vs-normal rise mostly reflects macrophage content; survival is not flagged adverse.

caveats: Discovery candidates are ranked hypotheses; no dependency or functional evidence supports any of them, and literature counts are by gene symbol.
Convergence-ranking top genes ALDOB, SLC22A8, UMOD, PIGR and FABP1 are tumour-down proximal tubule genes (biomarkers of loss), not targets; they were not attributed by cell type here.
CD70 and NNMT cell attribution did not return citable evidence ids, so statements on them are qualitative or rely on purity/TCGA records.
EGFR, SCARB1 and COXFA4L2 were not examined in detail within the call budget.
Structure scores are a monomer cavity heuristic; they do not identify degrons or predict degradation.
purity_effect is a model-based extrapolation and cannot alone prove tumour-cell origin; the scRNA-seq cohort is 12 donors with few endothelial, PT and fibroblast donors.
